messages:
Emma (CS): Ming — saw your note about the client onboarding causing a spike of 429s in staging. Can you paste the snippet of the warmup job and a sample response?
Ming (Customer): sure. We have a Lambda that spins 25 parallel invocations to prime connections. Response sample: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
{"error":"rate_limited","phase":"preflight"}
We also set token TTL to 45s and refresh on each worker boot.
Emma (CS): thanks. Are you on the published JS SDK or a custom preflight flow?
Ming (Customer): using redwood-js 1.3.0. We call `await Client.create()` in each invocation.
Leah (SDK): common pattern — parallel create() calls from many cold starts can produce a preflight storm. SDK supports `createPool` and `createThrottle` helpers to avoid this, but docs could be clearer.
Jasper (Eng): server-side we track namespace bursts; we can widen the short-term burst allowance for your account for 20 minutes while you test. Ping when ready.
Ming (Customer): appreciated. In the meantime any client-side quick fixes?
Leah (SDK): quick changes you can try immediately:
- Use `initPool(2)` so only two concurrent init flows happen per host.
- Add randomized startup delay (100-1000ms) across invocations.
- Switch to `reuseToken=true` with a refresh gate so only one process refreshes at a time.
Example: ```js
const pool = await RedwoodClient.initPool({ concurrency: 2, tokenGraceSecs: 8, startJitterMs: [100,1000] });
const client = pool.getHandle();
```
Ming (Customer): good tips. We can try `initPool`. Can you also advise on backoff strategy? We currently retry immediately up to 3 times.
Leah (SDK): add exponential backoff with jitter: base 300ms, factor x2, cap 5s. That avoids synchronized heavy retries.
Ming (Customer): toggled pool concurrency and backoff, adding 200-800ms jitter. Re-running warmup.
ci-bot: deploy 1719799900 -> staging-warmup succeeded :white_check_mark:
Jasper (Eng): just increased your preflight burst window by 1.8x for the next 30m. Watch the internal rate chart I shared.
Ming (Customer): warmup run shows improvement. A couple of 429s at start but most in 200. Sample logs: 
[2026-03-23T18:12:10Z] invoke-07 preflight 200
[2026-03-23T18:12:11Z] invoke-02 preflight 429 Retry-After:1
[2026-03-23T18:12:12Z] invoke-02 retry -> 200
Emma (CS): great — I'll document this case as a serverless warmup checklist: pool, jitter, token reuse, and backoff. Ming, would a one-page checklist or a code example in the quickstart be most helpful?
Ming (Customer): one-pager with a tiny code example would have saved us time. Also call out token TTL pitfalls.
Leah (SDK): noted — creating a small quickstart PR with a serverless section.
Emma (CS): closing this thread; feel free to re-open if anything regresses. Thanks everyone. :pray:
